[[File:Molator-SW100Objects.png|thumb|250px|Grimtaash the [[Molator/Legends|Molator]].]]

'''Grimtaash''' was a being from [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaanian]] myth. According to legend, the spirit of the [[Molator/Legends|Molator]] Grimtaash protected the royal house of Alderaan from corruption and betrayal.

Grimtaash, or a similar Molator, was one of the [[Holomonster/Legends|holomonsters]] on a [[Dejarik/Legends|dejarik]] board on the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']].

{{Stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
''[[Dark Nest II: The Unseen Queen]]'' uses the alternate spelling "'''grimtassh'''".
